notes: Scrolling text in screen recordings and rolling credits is no longer softened by mistake: Crisp now checks that footage is really interlaced before it rebuilds frames. Smooth motion has a 4x setting, so a 30 fps clip can play at 120 fps. You can save your Enhance settings as your own presets and pick them again later. The Jobs list stays readable in a narrow window, and the Denoise menu says what Auto will do for the preset you chose.
